svg.title: DGM-ERD-003 V2 full physical ERD — 24 tables
svg.desc: Physical schema view of every implemented table, key columns and foreign keys.
svg.text: Crow's-foot semantics are expressed by FK direction/cardinality labels: each child FK points to its parent; nullable FKs permit 0..1 parent. Parent-side child multiplicity is 0..* unless constrained otherwise.
